title: MV Help with Lunatic Mode for YEP Buff & State Core

posts.author: VHStapes
posts.body:
Hey everyone, me again!
I am trying to use YEP Buff & State Core to create a state that deals damage each turn to the effected battler based on the number of turns left on the state. To be exact, I want it to deal 10% of the effected battler's max hp as damage per turn left on the state. So if the battler has 3 stacks of this state, they will take 30% of their max hp as damage at the start of their turn. I tried hobbling it together but couldn't get it to actually deal damage, I'm guessing I don't know how to reference the number of turns left correctly.
Thanks!

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
VHStapes said:
I tried hobbling it together but couldn't get it to actually deal damage, I'm guessing I don't know how to reference the number of turns left correctly.
Click to expand...
how had you tried to do it before? it could have been a typo. the base engine has a _stateTurns array property that holds the current state durations and yanfly added a getter function to it in that plugin. try
Code:
<Custom Turn Start Effect>
user.gainHp(-Math.ceil(user.mhp/10*user.stateTurns(stateId)))
</Custom Turn Start Effect>

if was on an enemy then try this. The damage may have been dealt but there just might not have been a damage popup to show it.
Code:
<Custom Turn Start Effect>
user.gainHp(-Math.ceil(user.mhp/10*user.stateTurns(stateId)))
user.startDamagePopup()
</Custom Turn Start Effect>
If it was an enemy then itd be harder to notice a health change without an hp gauge plugin
